text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
It's a genuine masterpiece, for real! 
Don't you think so too?

Sirius Symboli didn't appear downcast on 
the surface, but it looked as if she was 
actively forcing herself to be that way.

I want to hear how she truly feels, but 
what should I say to her...?
choice_data_list: We can't let it end like this.
We can't just let it end like this, right?

text_block_list.text:
I want to hear how she truly feels, but 
what should I say to her...?
choice_data_list: We can't let it end like this.
We can't just let it end like this, right?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Are you being serious right now? 
After *that*? You're telling me that 
pathetic race wasn't bad?
choice_data_list: There were some good parts to it, too.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
A loss is a loss. Whatever a loser says... 
...is nothing more than a loser's howl.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
……Never again…… do I want to run a race 
like that, or suffer such humiliation.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
...I won't forget the taste of this dirt. 
Next time, I'll make them taste it 
instead.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Oh? Thinking you're big enough to fire me 
up, huh?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: ...Fine by me. I'll take you up on that.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
There's no way in hell someone like me is 
gonna go down in a place like this.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We're reorganizing. It's going to get 
tougher. You can keep up, can't you, 
little pup?

"Although her true feelings remained 
unsaid, Sirius Symboli regained her usual 
composure and flashed a fearless grin."
